title.narrative: MCF WFP Youths in Work Project in Adamawa State

description.narrative: Christian Aid Nigeria is implementing a Youth In Work project through WFP-Mastercard Foundation funding to improve climate-smart agricultural production and strengthening food systems, making it more efficient, sustainable and inclusive to promote increased Value Chain Employment Opportunities. The main objectives of this project include Entrepreneurship Development to improve the entrepreneurship skills of over 7,000 youths (18-35 years), through entrepreneurial training/capacity building to individuals and enterprises in selected value chains in Adamawa State. It will also provide Market Linkages to enhance financial inclusion and access to business opportunities, financial and non-financial services for the individuals and enterprises trained. Products and Services will be based on a Sustainable Business Models to be designed and implemented as a viable business model for the supported enterprises to ensure that the entrepreneurial training and additional business development services are sustained. The project’s intervention covers Madagali, Michika, Mubi North, Mubi South, Hong and Gombi LGAs of Adamawa State.
